info.title: Supergood Solutions public API
info.summary: Public reads of the rate card, service list and blog (paginated), NLWeb /ask search over the blog, the fit-check POST with Idempotency-Key, and a sandbox that sends nothing.
info.description:
The fit check is POST https://api.supergood.solutions/api/v1/intake. Two GET documents, /pricing.json and /services.json, are static files on https://supergood.solutions. No API key, bearer token, or account is required. See https://supergood.solutions/auth.md.

Idempotency. POST /api/v1/intake accepts an Idempotency-Key header (1 to 200 printable characters, no spaces). A retry with the same key and the same body within 24 hours does not send a second email. The same key with a different body is 422 idempotency_conflict. Without the header, each POST sends one email.

Sandbox. POST /api/v1/sandbox/intake takes the same body, runs the same validation and sends nothing.

Rate limits. Every intake response carries RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining, RateLimit-Reset and RateLimit-Policy. A 429 adds Retry-After. /api/v1/intake allows 10 requests per 10 minutes per IP and /api/v1/sandbox/intake allows 30. The limit is kept in memory per server instance, so treat it as approximate.

Versioning. The API is version 1 and every intake response carries API-Version: 1. This document is 1.1.0. 1.1.0 added the Idempotency-Key header, the sandbox, the RateLimit headers and the JSON 404, and removed nothing. The unversioned paths /api/intake and /api/sandbox/intake are aliases of the v1 paths and keep working. A breaking change ships as a new path, for example /api/v2/intake. The old path keeps working for at least 90 days after the change is announced on https://supergood.solutions/developers/ and in this description, and during those 90 days it returns Deprecation and Sunset headers. Adding a response field or an optional request field is not a breaking change. pricing.json and services.json are unpaged and cannot send Sunset or Deprecation headers (GitHub Pages), so a change to them is announced on the developers page.

The same fit check is the submit_fit_check tool on the MCP server at https://api.supergood.solutions/api/mcp (card: https://supergood.solutions/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json).

Deprecation and Sunset. During a deprecation window the old path adds a Deprecation header and a Sunset header (an HTTP date). Neither is sent today because nothing is deprecated.

429.description: More than 120 requests from one IP in a minute. Retry-After gives the seconds to wait.

post.description: Emails the inquiry to Ryan Sandoval. Send one request per person. Send an Idempotency-Key header so a retry cannot send a second email. No auth. Browser pages on https://supergood.solutions receive Access-Control-Allow-Origin for this URL. The form at /start/ will not submit until 3 seconds after the first field focus. A body with elapsedMs under 3000 or a filled company field returns 200 and sends no email, so do not treat elapsedMs as a server-side lock. Leave company as an empty string. Put the employer in companyName. To test without sending anything, use POST /api/v1/sandbox/intake.

example.name: Ada Lovelace
example.handoff: A Monday report rebuilt by hand from three spreadsheets.

200.description: The inquiry was accepted. Ryan reads it and replies.

400.description: The body or the Idempotency-Key header was rejected. error is json when the body is not a JSON object, required when name, email, or handoff is missing, email when the address is not valid, paysForTools when the value is not Yes, Not sure, or No, and idempotency_key when the Idempotency-Key header is not 1 to 200 printable characters with no spaces. Read hint, fix the request, and send once.

get.summary: List blog posts, newest first, one page at a time.
get.description: Cursor pagination. Send limit (1-50, default 20). For the next page send the next_cursor value from the previous page as cursor. next_cursor is null on the last page, and a Link header with rel="next" carries the same URL. No side effects. No auth.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque next_cursor from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

Link.description: RFC 8288 link to the next page, rel="next". Absent on the last page.

400.description: limit out of range or cursor not valid.

405.description: Only GET and HEAD are served.

get.summary: Ask a question and get the blog posts that answer it (NLWeb 0.55, GET).
get.description: NLWeb /ask in list mode. Send exactly one of query or q. Add streaming=true, or Accept: text/event-stream, for SSE. No side effects. No auth.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The question, 2 to 500 characters. Send this or q.

PricingDocument.description: The published rate card. Same offers as https://supergood.solutions/pricing/. Served as a static file.

provider.description: Name of the business that publishes the rate card.

url.description: Human-readable pricing page this document mirrors.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the numeric prices.

updated.description: Calendar date the document was last edited, YYYY-MM-DD.

offers.description: Every offer, in order from the free fit check to the monthly Run retainer.

tooling.description: Who pays for software, APIs and seats. Plain-language statement, not a price.

Offer.description: One priced offer. An offer carries price (fixed) or priceFrom (starting price), not both. Gain-share and credit fields appear only on the offers they apply to.

id.description: Stable machine identifier, for example fit-check, quick-scan, build or run.

price.description: Fixed price in currency. Present when the offer has a single price.

priceFrom.description: Lowest published price in currency. The quoted price can be higher.

unit.description: What the price is charged per, for example one-time, workflow or month.

summary.description: One or two sentences describing the offer and its terms.

url.description: Page where the offer starts, when it has one.

creditedTowardBuildIfSignedWithinDays.description: Days after the Quick Scan within which signing a build credits the Quick Scan fee toward it.

gainSharePercent.description: Share of measured gain over an agreed baseline, as a percentage range.

gainShareCapMultiple.description: Gain share is capped at this multiple of the monthly retainer.

ServicesDocument.description: The published service list. Five service pages with a one-line summary each. Served as a static file.

provider.description: Name of the business that publishes the service list.

url.description: Page that introduces the services this document lists.

updated.description: Calendar date the document was last edited, YYYY-MM-DD.

services.description: Every public service page. Not paged.

id.description: Stable machine identifier, the page slug.

email.description: Work email Ryan should reply to.

handoff.description: The manual work they want off the team's plate, in their words.

paysForTools.description: Are you OK paying for the software and tools your workflows run on, on your own accounts? The form and the MCP tool require it. The endpoint accepts a request without it.

company.description: Honeypot. Send an empty string. The employer name goes in companyName.

enum: Running, but we don't trust it
currentState.description: Where the work sits today. Optional. Empty string if unknown.

teamSize.description: How many people touch the work. Optional.

timeline.description: When they want to move. Optional.

source.description: Where the request came from. The form sends supergood.solutions/start. The in-page tool sends supergood.solutions/webmcp.

elapsedMs.description: Milliseconds since the person started the form. The function drops a value under 3000: it answers 200 and sends no email.

FitCheckAccepted.description: The inquiry was accepted. Also returned, with no email sent, when the form's spam checks drop it.

FitCheckError.description: Every error from the API host (api.supergood.solutions). error is a stable code, message says what went wrong, hint says how to fix it.

error.description: Stable error code. Branch on this value.

message.description: What went wrong, in a sentence.

sandbox.description: Always true: the request was validated and nothing was sent.

message.description: Plain-language confirmation that no email was sent.

SandboxAccepted.description: The body is valid. Returned by the sandbox endpoint. No email is sent.

IntakeIndex.description: JSON index of the endpoints on the intake host, returned by GET /.

version.description: API major version as a string, currently 1.

endpoints.description: Every endpoint on the intake host, including the MCP server.

method.description: HTTP method, for example GET or POST.

items.description: One endpoint on the intake host.

url.description: Canonical URL of the post. Append index.md-style twin by replacing the trailing slash with .md.

section.description: Blog section, such as Analysis or Guardrails.

description.description: One- or two-sentence summary from the RSS feed. Null when the feed has not caught up with the post.

PostPage.description: One page of posts, newest first.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Null on the last page.

total.description: Number of posts across all pages.

AskResult.description: One matching post, NLWeb result shape.

score.description: Relevance relative to the best match (1).

AskResponse.description: NLWeb 0.55 list-mode response. Ranked by keyword match; no generated answer.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Optional. 1 to 200 printable ASCII characters, no spaces, such as a UUID. A retry with the same key and the same body within 24 hours does not send a second email. The same key with a different body returns 422 idempotency_conflict. Keys are scoped to the caller's IP address.

RateLimitLimit.description: Requests allowed in the current window.

RateLimitRemaining.description: Requests left in the current window.

RateLimitPolicy.description: The policy as limit;w=window-seconds, for example 10;w=600.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before retrying. Sent on 429.

Deprecation.description: Sent only on a path in a deprecation window. Not sent today.

Sunset.description: HTTP date after which a deprecated path may stop working. Sent only in a deprecation window, at least 90 days ahead. Not sent today.
